rules.rationale: Explicit command boundaries prevent unreviewed execution.
rules.assertion: Every requested command is allowed by the profile policy.
rules.remediation: Use an allowed command or request an explicit policy update.
limitations: This does not prove a command is safe for every repository.

rules.rationale: Bounded control-flow complexity keeps changes reviewable.
rules.assertion: Measured cyclomatic complexity does not exceed the profile ceiling.
rules.remediation: Split branches into smaller functions and rerun evaluation.
limitations: The metric does not assess domain correctness.

rules.rationale: Dependency policy makes supply-chain and footprint choices explicit.
rules.assertion: Denied dependencies are absent from the selected workspace scope.
rules.remediation: Remove the denied dependency or document and approve the policy change.
limitations: The check does not replace vulnerability scanning.

rules.rationale: Implicitly untyped values weaken the declared type boundary.
rules.assertion: The selected TypeScript sources contain no forbidden any usage.
rules.remediation: Replace any with a precise type or an explicitly documented boundary.
limitations: Generated and non-TypeScript code may be outside this check.

rules.rationale: Dynamic evaluation defeats static review and expands execution risk.
rules.assertion: The selected TypeScript sources contain no eval call.
rules.remediation: Use a typed, explicit dispatch or parser instead of eval.
limitations: Runtime behavior outside parsed files is not assessed.

rules.rationale: Production logging should use the repository's observable logging boundary.
rules.assertion: Direct console logging follows the profile policy.
rules.remediation: Route operational output through the configured logger or document the exception.
limitations: A static check cannot judge whether a log message is operationally useful.

rules.rationale: Data locality rules keep relational isolation close to the data boundary.
rules.assertion: Application-layer join patterns do not violate the active profile policy.
rules.remediation: Move the join into the approved data boundary or record a reviewed exception.
limitations: The heuristic requires domain review for unusual query abstractions.

rules.rationale: Credentials embedded in source can leak through version control, logs, and artifacts.
rules.assertion: Secret-shaped source values are not committed as literals.
rules.remediation: Load the value through the approved environment or secret-management boundary and rotate any exposed credential.
limitations: Heuristic name and length matching cannot detect every secret or prove that a placeholder is harmless.

rules.rationale: Compiler diagnostics expose unresolved names and invalid API shapes before runtime review.
rules.assertion: The selected TypeScript project emits no configured compiler diagnostics in production source.
scope: TypeScript and JavaScript source included by tsconfig
rules.remediation: Resolve the compiler diagnostic, add the correct dependency or type declaration, and rerun evaluation.
limitations: Compiler diagnostics depend on the repository's tsconfig and dependency installation; they do not prove runtime or external API behavior.

evidence.sourceClaim: Compiler-backed unresolved API detection; this is not a network lookup or whole-framework compatibility proof.
evidence.implementation: packages/evaluator/src/index.ts runs ts-morph pre-emit diagnostics and maps them to file and location evidence.

rules.rationale: Unused initialized bindings add bloat and obscure the behavior that a reviewer must trust.
rules.assertion: Named initialized variables in the selected source scope have a reference or are explicitly intentional.
rules.remediation: Remove the unused declaration, use it, or prefix an intentionally unused binding with an underscore.
limitations: This does not identify all dead exports, unreachable branches, or semantically redundant helpers.

evidence.sourceClaim: LMP-local conservative dead-code heuristic; it is not a complete whole-program reachability proof.
evidence.implementation: packages/evaluator/src/index.ts resolves TypeScript symbols and reports initialized non-exported bindings with zero references.

rules.rationale: Repeated implementation bodies increase maintenance drift and make review coverage ambiguous.
rules.assertion: Selected source does not contain materially identical function bodies above the configured threshold.
rules.remediation: Extract shared behavior only when the domain contract is genuinely shared; otherwise document why the duplication is intentional.
limitations: Normalization is syntax-local and does not detect semantically equivalent algorithms with different spelling.

evidence.sourceClaim: LMP-local duplicate-body heuristic; it is not a semantic clone detector.
evidence.implementation: packages/evaluator/src/index.ts normalizes function bodies and reports repeated bodies at or above the configured threshold.

rules.rationale: Permissive cross-origin and unsafe DOM defaults can turn an otherwise correct implementation into an exposed boundary.
rules.assertion: Selected source does not use the configured unsafe default patterns without an explicit reviewed boundary.
rules.remediation: Use an explicit origin allowlist, trusted sanitizer, or safe data-boundary API and test the rejection path.
limitations: The detector covers named syntactic defaults; it does not prove complete XSS, CORS, or framework security.

evidence.sourceClaim: LMP-local named-property heuristic for high-risk permissive defaults; it is not a full application-security scanner.
evidence.implementation: packages/evaluator/src/index.ts reports configured unsafe DOM and permissive origin properties from the parsed AST.
